sections.title: Before you press record
sections.why: Same frame every time. Cut together, the jar changes and nothing else does. That is the whole series.

lines.d: Same tripod spot, same height, same angle.
Lens wiped, vertical, do not disturb on, room quiet.

sections.title: The shots
sections.why: Vertical, 9:16. Every clip keeps its own sound. Start each shot before the movement starts, stop after it ends.

lines.d: 10 seconds in the locked frame, nobody touching it. The before.
Get in close and hold 5 seconds on the thing you're going to talk about.
Open the lid, smell, stir, feed, discard, press down, burp. With its sound.
Anything measurable on camera: the scale, the thermometer, the band. Skip if there is none today.
The jar back on its mark in the locked frame. The after.

sections.title: The selfie talk
sections.why: Phone in your hand, face to camera, jar in the shot. 30 to 60 seconds, English. Jot a word or two in each box first if it helps, then talk it through. Two takes.

lines.d: Describe it like the viewer can't see the screen.

lines.t: What can go wrong right now
lines.d: What would make you worry at this stage, and what it would look like.
Smell, sound, texture, speed. The thing only someone with experience notices.

lines.t: What I'm doing today, and why
lines.d: The one action, in one sentence.
When you check it again, and what should have changed by then.

lines.t: "Follow so you can see how this jar turns out."
lines.d: Or your own words. Don't promise a date you might miss.

lines.t: Open with the day number. That is the hook.
Every episode stands alone. Never say "yesterday" or "last episode", someone is meeting this jar for the first time.
Something looks wrong? Film it before you fix it. The scary days are the best episodes.
Show it, then say it: if you talk about bubbles, the camera is already on the bubbles.
Delicious first. No gut health or probiotics on camera.

lines.d: Sound clear, jar in focus, face in the light.
All the clips from today, the way you always send footage.
